Notifications.Text: Edda: No monsters this time, Captain. Just Lord Corvane, his whole household, and the best farmland on the island between you.
Edda: Three Castles: ours, his, and an empty one in the middle that neither of you can afford to let the other keep. Hold all three and he has nowhere left to sit.
Edda: There are villages, farms and quarries all the way across. This will be won by whoever is still recruiting at the end.
The middle Castle belongs to nobody yet. It takes four captures, so bring two units or expect to stand there for two turns, and expect company.
Edda: Corvane's household troops have come up to his Castle.
Edda: That's his own banner, Captain, and Paladins under it. He has decided to stop losing.
Edda: The middle Castle is ours. He will want it back badly. Garrison it.
Edda: Corvane has the middle Castle. Two of three. Take it off him before he digs in.
